Gelatin Custard
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 11:07pm

Ingredients




4 Egg yolks
1/2 cup Sugar
2 1/2 cups Milk
Peel of 1 lemon, grated
2 1/2 tablespoons Powdered unflavored gelatin

Preparation

1 Beat the egg yolks with the sugar in a heatproof bowl for about 5 minutes. 2 Stir in the milk and the grated lemon peel. Dissolve gelatin following box instructions. Place the the bowl containing the lemon custard over gently simmering water and cook, stirring continuously, until mixture starts to thicken. Remove from heat and stir in the gelatin. Stir very thouroughly until the custard start to cool. Leave to set. 3 Serve with cake or with sugared berries. 4 Makes 4-6 servings.
